target_customer: Hardware and automotive engineering teams, starting with motorsport teams, then OEMs and suppliers.
problem: Engineers spend hours or days analyzing failures across test campaigns and pulling data and KPIs from separate systems and simulation tools.
business_model: Enterprise software platform (moveOS), deployable in the customer's cloud; pricing not public
product_category: AI agents for hardware and automotive engineering data

founders.name: Girish Radhakrishnan
founders.background_notes: About 10 years in automotive per YC page.

founders.name: Bruno Finco
founders.background_notes: Lead forward deployed engineer in automotive for about 10 years per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that drive simulation tools (Adams, MATLAB, Abaqus) and unify test data for automotive customers; integration heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Motorsport customer relationships and deep tool integrations are sticky, but general data agents could be extended by industrial analytics vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy or acquisition found as of 2026-11; Sight Machine added agent features in mid 2026 but for production line data.

market_need_then: YC page says the company closed a 30K first deal within two weeks of a proof of concept with Tractian; website lists racing teams such as Arrow McLaren as customers.

branding.domain_note: Company site movedot.ai while YC contact email uses movedot.com; history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and practical, engineer focused (company site).

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily confused with MOV.AI, Move AI and Moveo.AI in search results; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: MOVEdot sells AI agents to motorsport and automotive engineers, a niche where the founders worked for about a decade. Early customers are named on its site. Funding is unverified and no exit or distress is reported, so the outcome is unknown.
notes: Seedtable lists a 650K seed in 2025-09 (NXTP Ventures) and FundedIQ lists 500K pre-seed 2025-12; aggregator only, so unverified and not recorded as a round. No dated competitor sources found near the batch, so the list is empty. Founder education not found. Completeness pass: a 650K seed dated 2025-09 is recorded from Seedtable alone, a single database (NXTP Ventures named; six investors listed); FundedIQ instead lists a 500K pre seed in 2025-12, so the sources conflict.
